title: The pillars of healthy aging
summary: Preserving your physical, mental and metabolic capacities as you age.

blocks.text: Foreword

Aging is a natural phenomenon that concerns each of us. While the passage of time is inevitable, the way we age depends largely on our lifestyle habits. The goal is not only to live longer, but above all to preserve one's independence, energy, intellectual abilities and quality of life for as long as possible.

Medical progress has made it possible to increase life expectancy in most countries. However, living longer is only truly worthwhile if these additional years are lived in good physical, psychological and social conditions.

Aging results from many complex biological mechanisms: oxidative stress, chronic inflammation, reduced cellular repair, gradual loss of muscle mass and hormonal changes. Fortunately, many factors influencing these mechanisms can be improved through diet, physical activity, sleep and lifestyle.
The Family Clinic approach regards healthy aging as an active process based on daily choices that benefit the body.
Understanding aging
Aging is not a disease.
It corresponds to a gradual change in the body characterized by:

blocks.text: These phenomena appear naturally with age, but the speed at which they progress varies greatly from one person to another.

Conclusion

Healthy aging is one of the greatest challenges of our time. While aging is inevitable, its quality depends largely on the choices made throughout life. A health-promoting diet, regular physical activity, restorative sleep, stable emotional balance and a rich social life are the main pillars of healthy longevity.
According to the Family Clinic approach, each individual has considerable power to act on their aging trajectory. The habits adopted today build tomorrow's health.
